Four verse-initial speech onsets punctuate the span without reopening it: "וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוָה֮ אֶֽל יְשַׁעְיָהוּ֒" (oshb:Isa.7.3, byte tier), matching “Then Yahweh said to Isaiah” (web:Isa.7.3); "כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֖ר אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֑ה" (oshb:Isa.7.7, byte tier), matching “This is what the Lord Yahweh says” (web:Isa.7.7); "וַיּ֣וֹסֶף יְהוָ֔ה דַּבֵּ֥ר אֶל אָחָ֖ז לֵאמֹֽר" (oshb:Isa.7.10, byte tier), matching “Yahweh spoke again to Ahaz, saying,” (web:Isa.7.10); and "וַיֹּ֕אמֶר שִׁמְעוּ נָ֖א בֵּ֣ית דָּוִ֑ד" (oshb:Isa.7.13, byte tier), matching “Listen now, house of David” (web:Isa.7.13). These four stand inside the third-person narrative frame opened at web:Isa.7.1 rather than beside it, so the frame owns the embedded speech and nothing among the four reopens the row; the same narrative frame does not extend past its own close, which is why its defective-spelled resumptive twin at oshb:Isa.8.5 opens a fresh row rather than continuing this one.
